title: I11 HUBBLE SKYVAULT engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

exposure_manifest.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.
exposure_manifest.x-quality-rule: Include inaccessible/failed records and selection status.

raw_counts.x-quality-rule: Quality masks retained; missing pixels absent.

variant_reference.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

sky_statistic.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

context.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

calibration_difference.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
